description: Config for ci/config.json. Every key is optional; a missing file degrades to defaults. Keys starting with _ are comment keys and are ignored. The tool itself validates unknown keys at run time (unknown key = error).

doc_counts.description: Counts to record, each with an optional expected/min/max assertion.

pattern.description: Glob for files kind (default *); regex for matches kind.

mode_check.description: Check that every named executable carries its exec bit on disk.

project.description: Project name in the verdict file. Default: the repo dir name.

status_file.description: Verdict file at the repo root.

suite_command.description: Suite command, as a list or a single string (split on whitespace). Default when tests/ exists: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests. When tests/ does not exist and no suite_command is set, the suite check SKIPs.

suite_count_pattern.description: Regex with one group, run over the suite log to find the test count; the last match wins.

suite_timeout.description: Seconds before the suite is killed and marked FAIL.

tmp_base.description: Where throwaway work dirs live. Default: $LOCAL_CI_TMP, then ~/workspace/tmp when it exists, else the system temp dir.

zip.description: Build a throwaway Release-shaped zip and verify its stored modes.

zip_exclude_dirs.description: Dirs skipped by the zip build, the repo-size count, and files doc counts.

zip_exclude_suffixes.description: Filename suffixes skipped the same way.

zip_executable_globs.description: Globs that also ship executable (matched against the path and the basename). Glob-matched files are not checked on disk.

zip_executables.description: Root-relative paths that ship with the exec bit. Names listed here are required: missing is a failure.

zip_executables_file.description: A manifest file in the repo (one root-relative path per line, # comments), the Forge Browser EXECUTABLES.txt shape. Names from it are required and merge with zip_executables.

zip_top.description: Top folder name inside the throwaway zip. Default: the repo dir name.
